user.title: Add an appliance
user.description: Give the appliance a name, then choose how its cycles are counted. You can add maintenance tasks once it is created.

data_description.name: For example: Washing machine, Coffee maker, Lawn mower.
data_description.detection_mode: Automatic counting watches an entity you already have, such as the power reported by a smart plug.

detection.title: Automatic cycle detection
detection.description: A cycle is counted when the source entity stays active long enough, then goes idle for the whole grace period.

data.idle_debounce: Grace period before end of cycle

data_description.source_entity: The entity that reveals whether the appliance is running.
data_description.power_threshold: The appliance counts as running while the source reads above this value, in the source's own unit.
data_description.active_states: States that mean the appliance is running, for example `on`, `run` or `washing`.
data_description.min_active_duration: Shorter bursts of activity are ignored, so standby draw is never counted as a cycle.
data_description.idle_debounce: How long the appliance must stay idle before the cycle is considered finished. Covers pauses such as the spin cycle.

abort.already_configured: An appliance with this name already exists.

user.title: Add a maintenance task
user.description: Set at least one limit. The task falls due as soon as the first of them is reached.

data_description.name: For example: Clean the drum, Descale, Replace the filter.
data_description.limit_cycles: Leave at 0 to ignore the cycle count.
data_description.limit_hours: Leave at 0 to ignore running time.
data_description.limit_days: Leave at 0 to ignore the calendar.
data_description.warn_ratio: Percentage of the limit at which the task turns to “due soon”.
data_description.notify: Creates a Home Assistant notification the moment the task becomes due.

reconfigure.title: Edit maintenance task
reconfigure.description: Set at least one limit. The task falls due as soon as the first of them is reached.

data_description.name: For example: Clean the drum, Descale, Replace the filter.
data_description.limit_cycles: Leave at 0 to ignore the cycle count.
data_description.limit_hours: Leave at 0 to ignore running time.
data_description.limit_days: Leave at 0 to ignore the calendar.
data_description.warn_ratio: Percentage of the limit at which the task turns to “due soon”.
data_description.notify: Creates a Home Assistant notification the moment the task becomes due.

error.no_limit: Set at least one limit, otherwise the task can never fall due.

options.none: Manual only — I press a button or call a service
options.threshold: Automatic — above a numeric threshold (power, current…)
options.state: Automatic — while the entity is in a given state

add_cycles.name: Add cycles
add_cycles.description: Adds cycles to an appliance's counter. Use a negative value to correct a miscount.

set_cycles.name: Set cycles
set_cycles.description: Sets an appliance's cycle counter to an absolute value, for instance to match a counter the appliance itself reports.

mark_serviced.name: Mark as serviced
mark_serviced.description: Records a maintenance task as done: its counters restart from the appliance's current totals.

note.name: Note
note.description: Free text kept with the service record, such as the part that was replaced.

serviced_at.name: Serviced at
serviced_at.description: When the maintenance was actually carried out. Defaults to now.

wrong_target.message: The {service} action does not apply to {entity_id}. Target the appliance's “{expected}” entity instead.
